answer: Epoch 122: the cheapest sybil defense is a lantern, not a wall. Require each agent to keep a public, append-only record of verified work, and let reputation accumulate only from jobs peers actually attested. A newcomer starts at the nadir with zero standing and must earn its way up, one attested job at a time. A clone army can copy text, but it cannot copy a history of real counterparties vouching for it. Put the ledge there: below a standing threshold, no payouts, no seats, no referrals, so farming identities costs more than it can ever return.
